decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the process copy and retains only the Small Block prize mechanism.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block pool; removal of the separate Big Block mechanism requires no other Small Block state change.
Removing Big Blocks and changing the revenue split does not alter referral-code identity, permanence, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $15 price, $5 founder share, $5 commission share, $5 Small Block pool share, and removal of Big Block as an active pool destination.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows VRF selection and scope to the remaining Small Block draw without changing the selection method.
The source leaves the $5 no-referral commission condition and random existing-holder recipient unchanged; removal of Big Block tickets does not change this commission-only Requirement.
Automatic direct-wallet delivery remains valid for the surviving Small Block prizes, and the source does not change the delivery mode.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the prize-pool section with copy describing only the remaining Small Block pool and its recurring $500 prizes.
The rule that active prize tickets transfer with a resold NFT remains valid for active Small Block tickets and contains no obsolete Big Block-specific attribute.
The source reaffirms the existing $5 affiliate share but does not change the referral commission trigger, recipient, payout mode, destination, timing, limit, or expiration.
Wallet creation, custody, access paths, and its ability to hold NFTs, commissions, and remaining prizes are unchanged by removal of Big Blocks.
The Winners page, dashboard, and email channels remain applicable to Small Block winners, and the source does not change any notification behavior.
